description:
**Problem**
store_runtime_error_payload drops details for WAL index/replay errors, and lock permission_denied omits path/operation details. REALTIME_ERRORS.md expects structured details for machine handling.

**Where**
- src/daemon/ipc.rs: store_runtime_error_payload (WalIndex/WalReplay)
- src/daemon/ipc.rs: store_lock_error_payload (PermissionDenied without details)

**Design**
- Extend error payload mapping to include details for WAL index/replay errors (e.g., store_epoch_mismatch, prev_sha_mismatch, index_corrupt).
- Include permission_denied details for lock IO ({path, operation}).

**Acceptance**
- WAL/index error payloads include structured details per registry.
- Permission denied on lock IO includes path and operation.

**Files**
- src/daemon/ipc.rs
- src/daemon/ops.rs
- src/core/error.rs (if new details types needed)
title: IPC error payloads: include details for WAL/index + lock permission_denied

description:
**Problem**
ReplRigOptions uses boolean flags (e.g. use_store_id_override, checkpoints_enabled) that hide intent and violate type_design.md; callers can misread or mix states.

**Design**
- Introduce small enums (e.g. StoreIdOverride::{Enabled, Disabled}, CheckpointMode::{Enabled, Disabled}) or a single ReplRigMode struct with typed fields.
- Replace bool fields in ReplRigOptions and update call sites/tests to use the enums.
- Keep defaults explicit via Default impl or helper constructors.

**Acceptance**
- [ ] No boolean flags remain for ReplRigOptions modes.
- [ ] Call sites updated to use typed enums.
- [ ] Tests compile and pass.

**Files**: tests/integration/fixtures/repl_rig.rs, tests/integration/daemon/repl_e2e.rs, tests/e2e.rs
title: Replace ReplRigOptions bool flags with typed enums

acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Open blocker in core prevents a sessions bead from being ready.
- [ ] Closing the core blocker unblocks the sessions bead.
- [ ] ready_eligible=false namespaces return no ready candidates.
- [ ] Tests cover cross-namespace blockers and parent/non-ready dep-kind distinctions.
description:
**Problem**
Ready and blocked-by computations currently inspect one namespace-local state. A sessions bead blocked by a core bead can be reported ready incorrectly.
design: Make ready/blocker computation use namespaced graph traversal. Enforce ready_eligible at namespace policy boundaries: non-ready namespaces remain queryable but do not emit ready work.
title: Ready/blocker semantics across namespace edges

acceptance_criteria:
**Acceptance**
- [ ] `ready_eligible=false` is absent from default ready and explicit namespace-ready behavior as currently intended.
- [ ] `persist_to_git=false` rejects checkpoint/export attempts with a policy-specific error.
- [ ] `replicate_mode=None`, `Anchors`, `Peers`, and `P2p` have matrix coverage for allowed/denied replication roles.
- [ ] Tests live with the owning crate/layer unless a real product seam requires `crates/beads-rs/tests`.
- [ ] No duplicate one-off integration harness is introduced.
description:
**Problem**
`persist_to_git`, `replicate_mode`, and `ready_eligible` now have enforcement paths, but the lifecycle epic needs regression tests that lock their behavior as part of the complete policy matrix.

**Files**
- lowest clean daemon/core/durability tests
- existing namespace integration tests only where cross-crate behavior is required
design:
**Design**
Add focused policy matrix tests for already-enforced namespace fields.

Keep tests at the owning layer: ready eligibility in query executor tests, checkpoint persistence policy in checkpoint scheduling/admin tests, and replicate mode in daemon-core durability or REPL manager/server tests.

notes.content: Prediscovery: ready policy coverage belongs near crates/beads-daemon/src/runtime/query_executor.rs tests; persist_to_git rejection belongs near CheckpointRuntime::validate_checkpoint_group_namespaces in crates/beads-daemon/src/runtime/core/checkpoint_scheduling.rs; replicate_mode=None inbound rejection is in crates/beads-daemon/src/runtime/core/replication.rs, with role/mode filtering also in runtime/repl/manager.rs and runtime/repl/server.rs. Prefer focused daemon tests before product tests.

title: Lock existing namespace policy enforcement with matrix tests
